name: reformer-builder-playground
description: Проект-образец для @reformer/builder: его открывают e2e-тесты билдера, и на нём же пробуют плагины

scripts.builder: npm run plugins:build && cross-env REFORMER_BUILDER_CONFIG=../reformer-builder-playground/.ui_builder/config.json npm --prefix ../reformer-builder run dev -- --port 5184
scripts.preset:reformer-ui-kit: npm run plugins:build && cross-env REFORMER_BUILDER_CONFIG=../reformer-builder-playground/.ui_builder/presets/reformer-ui-kit.json npm --prefix ../reformer-builder run dev
scripts.preset:reformer-hexa-ui: npm run plugins:build && cross-env REFORMER_BUILDER_CONFIG=../reformer-builder-playground/.ui_builder/presets/reformer-hexa-ui.json npm --prefix ../reformer-builder run dev
scripts.preset:rjsf-ui-kit: npm run plugins:build && cross-env REFORMER_BUILDER_CONFIG=../reformer-builder-playground/.ui_builder/presets/rjsf-ui-kit.json npm --prefix ../reformer-builder run dev
scripts.preset:rjsf-hexa-ui: npm run plugins:build && cross-env REFORMER_BUILDER_CONFIG=../reformer-builder-playground/.ui_builder/presets/rjsf-hexa-ui.json npm --prefix ../reformer-builder run dev
